name: Insulin
biological_role: Peptide hormone that signals cells to regulate glucose metabolism.

structure.assembly_description: A and B chains of mature human insulin; first of 10 deposited NMR conformers.

rendering.display_bond_inference: within residues, peptide C-N, nearby cysteine SG pairs; visual only

notes: The deposited insulin conformers were determined in zinc-free acidic solution; they are not a universal physiological structure.
